tagline: Derma Radiant Hydra Face Serum – Deep Hydration & Skin Brightening
intro: Derma Radiant Hydra Face Serum is a powerful hydrating formula designed to deeply nourish, hydrate, and revitalize your skin. This lightweight serum absorbs quickly into the skin, delivering intense moisture that helps keep your face soft, smooth, and naturally glowing.

The advanced formula helps plump the skin, improve skin texture, and enhance overall brightness while maintaining the skin’s natural balance. Regular use helps reduce dullness and promotes an even, radiant skin tone.

p: • Deeply hydrates and nourishes the skin
• Helps plump and smooth the skin
Apply 2–3 drops of serum on a clean face and gently massage until fully absorbed. Use morning and night for best results.

full: Derma Radiant Hydra Face Serum – Deep Hydration & Skin Brightening
